slides.title: What is Reverse Beamforming?
slides.notes: Ask first, then click through. Beamforming steers what an antenna array sends; reverse beamforming listens with the array and computes the direction of arrival from the arrival-time (phase) differences. BLEARVIS (IMWUT 2023) mounts such an array on the headset and fuses the angle of arrival of BLE tags with camera-based object detection.

items.alt: Four antennas send the same wave with delays 0, τ, 2τ and 3τ; the wavefronts add up to one beam towards a phone at the upper right
A wave from a BLE tag at the upper left reaches four antennas at times t, t+Δ, t+2Δ and t+3Δ; the angle θ between the vertical and the direction of the tag is marked

r.t: : several antennas send the same signal, each a little later than its neighbour. The waves add up in one direction (5G, Wi-Fi).
: several antennas receive one signal. From the differences in arrival time, we compute where it came from (angle of arrival).
